decisions.reason: Safety shoes are a direct extension of the firm's core protective footwear expertise, so its absorptive capacity supports learning and improvement.
Comfort insoles build on the firm's existing foot-measurement and footwear knowledge, enabling it to interpret feedback and refine the product.
Supportive insoles are closely related to the firm's existing footwear and foot-measurement capabilities, facilitating assimilation of early results.
The ergonomic safety shoe series, presented on its own page, signals strategic importance and draws on deep footwear know-how, so the firm can learn and keep it.
